exactGlobalRules.cardinality: Every fixed key declares Scalar or List once. Available Scalar has exactly one Value, no Values; available List has immutable homogeneous ordered Values, no Value. No null elements, nested lists, arbitrary records/objects or dynamic cardinality.
exactGlobalRules.integer: Native Int32/Int64 widths remain explicit; serialize canonical invariant decimal strings under V1. Zero and negative native sentinel values are preserved only with the field's explicit branch meaning, never confused with missing values.
exactGlobalRules.code: Native enum values use a registered Code family with native Int32 underlying metadata; source-string/derived technical codes have no invented enum width. Preserve exact symbolic spelling and no arbitrary string additions.
exactGlobalRules.listScope: Each List defines its authorized projection statically. Values=[] means no values in that authorized projection. No dynamic hidden-exists/filtered/count flag. Repeated recipient, aura, feature or spell instances remain Scalar rows with typed instance context unless this exact key is declared List.
exactGlobalRules.unavailable: Withheld, NotApplicable, NotRetained, ProjectionUnavailable and Unrepresented omit both Value and Values. A primitive kind/format does not authorize private source or missing data. Current/Immediate/Retained temporal meanings stay per key.
exactGlobalRules.quantity: RuleQuantity retains native normalized Int64 components (nonnegative numerator, positive denominator) and exactly one authorized native unit or approved scoped dimension. Only cast.purify.batch-amount is a Quantity fact in this registry; it uses actual lot UnitId. No magic fact or parameter here is newly assigned CopperValue or CommandScalar.
exactGlobalRules.time: All existing Time facts here are exact absolute native RuleTime instants in seconds, including expiry; no wall-clock or floating conversion. Null/default sentinels are resolved by native branch before encoding. Future duration/conditional obligation descriptors remain separate.
exactGlobalRules.grid: GridCell is exactly signed Int32 X/Y. Separate Consecrate center-x/y fact keys and input fields remain Integer/32; do not merge existing keys or convert arbitrary RuleQuantity positions into GridCell.
exactGlobalRules.sourceIdentifiers: Normalize legacy descriptive PublicSourceRevision40/PublicSourceSha256 aliases into the existing Identity kind with exact source-qualified 40/64 hex format and source role metadata. No new scalar kind, fingerprint export or case conversion.
exactGlobalRules.privacy: GPT05 controls original unapproved predicate labels: bounded own envelopes were agreed, but no blanket field/provenance/recipient grant. Retained Purify removals and Consecration attack contributions remain fixed Withheld families. Hide-linked Guidance end/consumption causes retain the explicit restriction.
exactGlobalRules.submissions: Native Command/constructor/parser encodings remain unchanged. Descriptor Code/List/Identity metadata does not replace native enum/int/string inputs or relax payload shape. Empty request strings are explicit parameter sentinels, never fabricated entity identities.
